title: Sacred Ground Cosmic Campaigns
batch: Batch One — Reality Has Left the Building
hard: Never invent SACRED GROUND type. Stamp media 21848 long or 21849 stacked on blank tapestry / bag / sign / window.
Add the headline in the design pass. Leave the upper band clear in the generation.
Circular sun is the corner mark only.
Stills first. Video concepts wait for Founder go. No TopView without permission.
Use approved brand assets when the shop appears.

concepts.label: The Last Supper Has a Scheduling Conflict
concepts.retired_why: Founder: do not go there — upsetting to Christians. No Last Supper, Jesus, apostles, or Christian holy-scene parody.
concepts.headline: Someone ordered the house crystal.
concepts.visual: RETIRED. Do not generate, schedule, or show.

concepts.label: Houston, We Have a Gift Shop
concepts.headline: We said bring something small back.
concepts.twist: The second astronaut is trying to fit Saturn back into the bag.
concepts.visual: Astronaut opens a tiny Sacred Ground bag on the moon. Full-size Saturn emerges. Rings knock over the rover.

concepts.label: The Department of Unexplained Purchases
concepts.headline: Anything to declare? Another dimension.
concepts.twist: A tiny customs officer from the other dimension inspects our agent through the monitor.
concepts.visual: Airport X-ray. Sacred Ground bag contains a spiral staircase to another civilization.

concepts.label: Botticelli’s Parking Problem
concepts.headline: Goddess energy. Mortal parking rules.
concepts.twist: Two cherubs feed pearls into the parking meter.
concepts.visual: Venus in a gigantic scallop shell occupying three spaces. Parking officer writing a ticket. Illustrative boutique, not the exact real storefront.

concepts.label: Einstein Takes a Personal Day
concepts.headline: Even spacetime needs to lie down.
concepts.visual: Einstein in a chair. Spacetime sags like a hammock.

concepts.label: The Black Hole Has Taste
concepts.headline: It came to consume everything. It got distracted.
concepts.twist: Light bends into a giant curious eye around the shop window.
concepts.visual: Black hole eats the street except Sacred Ground, stopped at a crystal.

concepts.label: The Minotaur Needs Directions
concepts.headline: Your spiritual journey has been recalculating.
concepts.twist: Every sign points to Sacred Ground. He is still lost.
concepts.visual: Overhead marble labyrinth. Tiny shop at the center. Minotaur on a wall with a phone.

concepts.label: The Museum Exhibit Escapes
concepts.headline: They stood still for centuries. Then we opened.
concepts.twist: A marble philosopher brought a folding chair.
concepts.visual: Statues queue outside at midnight. Pedestals follow like dogs.

concepts.label: First Contact, Excellent Customer Service
concepts.headline: Take us to your crystal person.
concepts.twist: The commander brought a rock to identify.
concepts.visual: Mothership tractor-beams a service bell onto the counter.

concepts.label: Downtown Has Been Upgraded
concepts.headline: Same downtown. Slightly larger universe.
concepts.visual: Front door opens onto a desert. A crystal cathedral walks on architectural legs.
